title: Inside Ankita Lokhande, Vicky Jain's Ganesh Chaturthi Celebrations With Arjun Bijlani, Neha Swami | Television News - News18
text: On the auspicious occasion of Ganesh Chaturthi, Ankita Lokhande and Vicky Jain welcomed Lord Ganesha into their home. On the first day of the celebrations, close friends and family members gathered at Ankita’s house. A video from inside the festivities has now surfaced online, giving fans a glimpse of the celebrities who joined in. The actress herself also shared a series of pictures from the celebration. In one video, Ankita and Vicky were seen posing with Shubhaavi Choksey, Arjun Bijlani, and his wife Neha Swami. All of them looked radiant in festive colours, Ankita and Shubhaavi in elegant red sarees, Neha in a bright red suit, while Vicky and Arjun twinned in classic white kurtas. The group was seen sharing laughs as they tried to strike a perfect yet candid pose together. Ankita Lokhande, Vicky Jain Seek Bappa’s Blessings Ankita Lokhande also posted a bunch of photos and videos on her Instagram handle. The caption read, “Bappa aagaye hain Mere ghar, mere dil ke Bappa Aap bhi darshan kijiye aur unke aashirwad paayiye Ganpati Bappa Morya!!!" Ankita and Vicky are seen bowing down before the Lord and seeking Bappa’s blessings. The second photo shows the couple with Ankita’s mother and other family members present during the celebrations. Ankita Lokhande, Vicky Jain’s Work Life Ankita Lokhande and Vicky Jain were most recently seen in Laughter Chefs 2, a humorous cooking reality show. The duo participated with much enthusiasm but fell short of winning the season. The show, hosted by Chef Harpal Singh Sokhi and Bharti Singh, premiered on January 25 and concluded on July 27 after a successful run. The season also featured popular names like Krushna Abhishek, Rahul Vaidya, Karan Kundrra, Nia Sharma, Reem Shaikh, Sudesh Lehri, Elvish Yadav, Rubina Dilaik, Aly Goni, and Kashmera Shah. Ankita and Vicky, who tied the knot in December 2021 in a grand ceremony at Mumbai’s Grand Hyatt, later appeared together on Bigg Boss 17, hosted by Salman Khan. Their eventful journey on the reality show garnered significant attention and headlines.
